page.layout: One blank page, no printed blocks. Only paper, stains and worm or spot marks at the right edge and lower right. The digitiser's scale bar, banner and link at the foot are not printed text.
page.notes: Blank page: no printed text, no running head, page number, catchword or signature. Stains and small spots are not print. The Herzog August Bibliothek scale bar and the HAB link at the foot belong to the digitiser and are left out. Faint marks at the left edge are show-through or paper texture, not text.
